2_parse_check.decoding_note: XML prolog says utf-8 but bytes are cp949; their cp949-first decode is correct (all 2488 parsed docs contain the section label)

3_leak_survivorship_joins.future_info: none found. rcept_dt is never earlier than the rcept_no date (184 docs have rcept_dt 1-4 days LATER, i.e. conservative); entry always after rcept_dt; marcap used only 2002-2009

observations_not_bugs: S1 mean rests on one event: a +225% 21-day excess (2008-04 filing, genuine price path, share count constant, daily limits hit). Without it S1 mean = -0.02%, t -0.04.
Same firm-date multiple reporters are separate events (433 events, 425 firm-dates); de-duplicated S1 +0.41%, t 0.55.
Context only (not gate inputs): entry lag 1/3 days gives S1 +0.29%/+0.50%, dating by rcept_no date +0.49%; 1%-winsorized S1 +0.18%.
t >= 2.24 would need S1 mean >= +1.67% at the observed sd 15.5%.
Hygiene: a raw document.xml probe file (run/A/probe/20030331001788.xml) sits in the session scratchpad; it may contain names and should be deleted. It is not used by any result.
final_verdict: CLOSE (stage 1). All three close conditions hold under the audit: mean +0.50% < +1.0%, t 0.67 < 2.24, 2002-07..2005-12 mean -0.16% < 0.
